description: This file defines API hook functions for trainer-related operations in a gym management system frontend. It includes functions to list, add, and remove trainer clients, as well as fetch recent client logs, utilizing a base API URL and a fetchWithAuth utility.

methods.name: getTrainerBase
methods.description: Returns the base URL for trainer API endpoints.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from a given path under the base URL.

methods.name: listTrainerClients
methods.description: Fetches a list of clients assigned to the current trainer, with fallback to a general trainers list.

methods.name: addTrainerClient
methods.description: Assigns a new client to the trainer via email or user ID.

methods.name: removeTrainerClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the trainer by ID.

methods.name: listRecentClientLogs
methods.description: Retrieves recent activity logs for the trainer's clients.
